scope: HTML/CSS interface chrome only. No gameplay, economy, save, canvas art, IDs, data attributes, ARIA roles or labels changed. No commits or git stash. Existing unrelated working-tree edits preserved.
implementationStatus: implemented; browser visual acceptance pending outside the sandbox

changes.1_frames: Master-palette walnut/honey cabinet frames and brass-edged cream cards, zero-blur pixel shadows, top-left highlights and bottom-right shades. Interface art pixel = 2 CSS px, independent of world camera zoom. Covers management, dialogs, onboarding, region cards, HUD, status, guidance, catalog cards, toasts and chips.
changes.2_buttons: Raised paper/sage/terracotta buttons, 2 CSS px pressed travel, non-color selected edge indicators, selected hover states, opaque readable disabled states and double-contrast keyboard focus. Includes customization swatches and choice cards.
changes.3_hierarchy: Shared name/money/day/rating/status/action materials, transparent overlay containers retained. Right tool faces inset 4 CSS px vertically and 2 horizontally inside unchanged hit rectangles, exposing more art. No responsive positioning, room fitting, zoom logic or drawer focus code changed.
changes.4_forms: Native checkbox semantics retained with square CSS checkmark; inset text/number fields, palette placeholders, stepped select chevrons, raised existing +/- controls, pixel progress tracks/fills and +/- disclosures. Native number spin controls and select popups retained. Forced-colors native fallback supplied.
changes.5_typography: Pixelify Sans and Pixel ZH retained; fields inherit locale font, phone fields/selects use 16px; no new fonts or text-content changes.

captureStates: Closed/open shop HUD; name, money, day/speed/close chips, rating/team/regulars, tools, bottom actions and room zoom controls.
All six management tabs with long catalogs; selected filters, affordability-disabled actions, bakery +/- controls, goal and progress, pause badge and scroll header.

Settings, money breakdown, reviews, regular journal, team, café style, signature drink research and region/map dialogs; long English and Chinese content.
Every onboarding step, especially color/hair swatches, name fields, theme choices and back/next actions.
checklist: Inspect at native capture resolution: warm 2 CSS px outlines, top-left highlights and bottom-right shades; no soft shadow blur or seams at DPR 1/2/3.
Check hover/pressed/selected/disabled/focus combinations, including selected chips, inset tool faces, drawer balance/close and customization swatches.
Tab/Shift+Tab/Escape through mobile drawer and dialogs; verify focus trapping, focus restoration, readable non-clipped focus rings and pause/resume badges.
Verify >=44px phone targets, including labels around 20px checkboxes and the existing separate +/- buttons. Ensure transparent tool margins still accept taps.
Verify no horizontal overflow (document scrollWidth <= clientWidth), unclipped catalog fields and Chinese copy, and independent panel/dialog scrolling.
Verify 320px portrait and short landscape with every overlay; safe-area edges, open/close buttons, doorway targets and zoom controls must remain reachable.
Verify room fitting, pinch zoom, panning, overview visibility and arranging overlays still behave unchanged.
Check OS/browser-owned number spinner glyphs and select popup readability, forced-colors mode, keyboard activation and reduced-motion mode.

remainingGaps: Actual browser screenshots, DPR paint crispness, responsive overflow/touch geometry and live focus/pinch/zoom acceptance remain unverified because this sandbox cannot run Chrome or bind a server.

Native number-spinner arrow glyphs and select popup internals remain platform-rendered. Their surrounding controls and existing +/- buttons are pixel styled; no custom replacement was introduced because it would change control behavior beyond styling-only scope.
